messages:
Ava: Idea: run a 30-person design partner pilot recruited by psychographic segments (product-builders, infra/ops, cost-optimizers). goal: compare success metrics and ask patterns across mindsets, not just company size.
Diego: Nice. Propose 3 screener qs to tag psychographic signals (30s). target 10 per segment.
Maya: We'll A/B incentives: 4 hours premium support vs $500 credit. track which drives feedback completion.
Jordan: For infra cohort, include a short runbook + optional 1:1 setup. product cohort gets prompt templates and eval recipes.
Priya: Need a 1-line consent checkbox covering anonymized logs + incentive terms. I'll draft copy.
Ava: High-level success metrics: product: 80% complete first integration + 1 feedback session within 14d; infra: perf baseline + infra notes from >=30%; cost: >=50% try Optimize suggestions with measurable token-cost change.
Diego: Measurement plan: funnel events (invite_sent, accept_ts, onboarding_complete_ts), feedback_sessions_count, nps_30, qualitative tags (blocker, feature_request). I'll share a CSV schema.
Maya: Recruitment copy test: "Ship faster with Redwood" (impact) vs "Cut inference costs" (efficiency). A/B and measure open->accept.
Jordan: Onboard checklist to automate:
- issue API key + sample call
- perf test (10 requests) auto-upload results
- join cohort slack
- schedule feedback session
Can we auto-run perf test and push CSV?
Sam: Ops can support 30 but stagger waves (10/week). will coordinate avail for 1:1s.
Priya: Confirmed: anonymized telemetry ok if consented. will post short legal blurb + credit accounting note.
Ava: Next steps: Diego = screener + schema; Maya = invite copy variants; Priya = consent text; Jordan = small perf test automation; Sam = schedule windows. I'll assemble rollout calendar.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: add cohort to dp-beta-queue and tag segment labels on screener pass. :robot_face:
Maya: Request: expose psychographic segment as a filter in evaluation dashboard for slicing feedback.
Diego: Sample CSV fields I'll include: participant_id, segment, accept_ts, onboarding_complete_ts, perf_avg_latency_ms, tokens_per_call, feedback_sessions_count, nps_30. will paste a tiny JSON sample in doc.
Ava: OK if no objections I'll open outreach next Tuesday. :thumbsup:
